parsed.why: School/college facility ban lacks enforcement and does not reach general public accommodations; care/sports bans and narrowed state documents add friction, leaving it slightly below the national baseline.
Strong state anti-discrimination, protected facilities access, hate-crime coverage and care-shield law lift it above the parent, but national passport/entry and custody exposures remain.
The division removed gender-identity civil rights and imposes a birth-certificate bathroom rule on all school grounds, including visitors, with no state remedy; worst-tier state.
Statutory public-accommodations, housing, credit and hate-crime protections plus accessible markers lift it; restrictions are mainly school/youth measures unlikely to reach adult visitors.
Its executive order and school law enforce birth-sex facilities, documents are closed to marker changes, care is banned for adults too, and no gender-identity protections apply.
